pages.text: $(thing)Fourier Series$()$(br2)Any repeating signal is a sum of pure tones. Fourier said so in 1807, and nobody believed him. Unlocks the Fourier Series.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Euler's Formula.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Imaginary Unit.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A signal jumps between +1 and −1 every half period. Write the size A of its n-th odd harmonic.
